caption:
AI is great at debugging. It's terrible at reading your mind.

"It doesn't work" gives it nothing. Give it three things instead:
1. The exact error, every line
2. The code it came from
3. What you expected vs what happened

You'll get a real fix on the first try way more often.

Send this to the friend who pastes "it doesn't work" into ChatGPT.
